meta.name: infinitetalk-shopping-avatar
meta.description: 电商运营与内容创作者在制作数字人带货视频时，使用本技能可自动生成适配InfiniteTalk的五幕分镜结构化提示词，精准管控角色一致性与音画同步，一键产出高质量9:16竖屏带货视频，让数字人带货更高效！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成数字人五幕分镜，产出竖屏带货视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在运营电商或做内容,需要快速制作数字人带货视频
copy.tagline_en: Generate five-act storyboard prompts for digital human shopping videos.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run e-commerce or create content and need quick digital-human shopping videos.

howto.what: 为 InfiniteTalk 生成小省导购员数字人带货视频的五幕分镜结构化提示词（每幕 5 秒、9:16 竖屏、1080×1920），核查角色一致性与音画同步，并输出参数配置表。
howto.when: 当你需要制作小省导购员数字人带货视频、用 InfiniteTalk 模型推理时触发；场景类型可为产品推荐、价格对比、促销活动等。

say.text: 帮我生成产品推荐场景的五幕带货提示词，情绪基调热情专业
say.note: 输出五幕中文提示词和参数配置表

say.text: 核查这套提示词的角色一致性和音画同步
say.note: 输出 pass/fail 质检报告与问题清单

say.text: 把这几幕提示词对接 Suno 音频和 InfiniteTalk 推理
say.note: 产出音频编码文件和五幕拼接视频

howto.what_en: Generates five-act structured prompts for InfiniteTalk shopping-avatar videos (5s per act, 9:16, 1080x1920), checks character consistency and audio sync, and outputs a parameter config table.
howto.when_en: Use when you need a Xiaosheng shopping-avatar video made with the InfiniteTalk model; scene types include product recommendation, price comparison, and promo campaigns, etc.

say_en.text: Generate five-act prompts for a product-recommendation video, tone warm and professional
say_en.note: Returns five-act prompts and a parameter config table

say_en.text: Check character consistency and audio sync in these prompts
say_en.note: Returns a pass/fail QC report and issue list

say_en.text: Connect these prompts to Suno audio and InfiniteTalk inference
say_en.note: Produces audio feature files and a stitched five-act video
